name: mosaic-desktop
description: Standalone Mosaic desktop application for Windows
author: Prime Philippines

scripts.prepare:local-app: npm --prefix app run build && node scripts/prepare-local-app.cjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:local-app && npm test && node scripts/generate-icons.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never && npm run checksum
scripts.dist:dir: npm run prepare:local-app && npm test && node scripts/generate-icons.cjs && electron-builder --dir --win --x64
